title.original: WebArena: A Realistic Web Environment for Building Autonomous Agents
title.zh: WebArena：构建自主智能体的真实网页环境
title.en: WebArena: A Realistic Web Environment for Building Autonomous Agents

inclusion_reason.zh: WebArena 提供可复现的完整网站、工具、知识库、长时程任务和功能正确性判定，是网页智能体执行与评测基础设施。
inclusion_reason.en: WebArena provides reproducible full websites, tools, knowledge bases, long-horizon tasks, and functional-correctness checks as execution and evaluation infrastructure for web agents.

abstract.zh: WebArena 构建覆盖电商、社交论坛、协作开发和内容管理的可复现真实网站环境，并发布面向日常长时程任务的基准。
abstract.en: WebArena builds reproducible realistic websites spanning commerce, social forums, collaborative development, and content management, together with a benchmark of long-horizon daily tasks.

problem.zh: 早期网页智能体多在简化合成环境中测试，无法反映真实网站状态、跨页面依赖、外部知识和任务完成的功能正确性。
problem.en: Earlier web agents were tested in simplified synthetic settings that omit real site state, cross-page dependencies, external knowledge, and functional correctness.

approach.zh: 作者部署可操作网站，加入地图和用户手册等工具与知识源，设计仿真人类日常操作的任务，并以最终网站状态验证完成。
approach.en: The authors deploy functional sites, add tools and knowledge sources such as maps and manuals, design tasks modeled on daily web use, and verify completion from final site state.

system_design.zh: 环境服务器承载网站与状态，智能体通过浏览器执行动作，任务规范定义初始条件和目标，验证器读取站点状态计算功能成功。
system_design.en: Environment servers host sites and state, agents act through a browser, task specifications define initial conditions and goals, and verifiers inspect site state for functional success.

key_results.zh: 官方摘要显示最佳 GPT-4 智能体成功率远低于人类，表明该环境能暴露真实网页任务中的显著能力缺口。
key_results.en: The official abstract shows the best GPT-4 agent far below human success, demonstrating that the environment exposes substantial capability gaps on realistic web tasks.

limitations.zh: 自托管网站仍不能完全复现开放互联网的变化、反机器人机制和安全风险；固定任务可能被专门调优，环境维护成本也较高。
limitations.en: Self-hosted sites cannot fully reproduce open-web drift, anti-bot systems, or safety risks; fixed tasks can be overfit and the environment is costly to maintain.

metrics.name: Best GPT-4-based agent task success rate

notes.zh: 模型、任务、硬件、基线与指标仅转录自官方 arXiv 摘要；摘要未披露的表格和部署细节仍待全文审计。
notes.en: Models, workloads, hardware, baselines, and metrics are transcribed only from the official arXiv abstract; undisclosed tables and deployment details still require full-text audit.
